cases.scenario_boundary: Fresh known2023 Austrian5ha home-farm holding with one hectare each of wine, qualitatively suitable grafted apple, hop, grafted walnut and grafted chestnut. All actual whole-farm herbicide abstention and purchasing/storage duties are positively established throughout the current multi-year commitment, not inferred from empty output. No PSM treatment, inventory item, OP/VF event, unreported circumstance, takeover, exit, BIO switch, incompatible measure, public overlap or authority reduction occurred. All claimed parcels actually filed for11, actively and properly managed/harvested for the whole commitment year; all relevant original records/register facts independently known. First participation2023 and actual2022-12-01 application establish the current commitment to2028. Annual payment claim submitted. No other area payments; all amounts below applicable cap and5homeha leave modulation1. Singular walnut/chestnut vocabulary is explicitly the native representation of these known species, not proof of official plural classifier coverage. Optional nonoccurring exit/switch/takeover dates are omitted rather than invented or normalized; independent Inputs probes own their nullable runtime behavior. No question of cutting-vineyard premium A02, A10 cap allocation or A13 BIO-switch legal interpretation is decided. Amounts are conditional source-derived components, not an AMA payment authorization.
